title: All Physiological & Habitat Systems Nominal
earthClinicTitle: Patient Vitals & Ambient Ward Environment Stable
diagnosticCriteriaSummary: SpO2 >= 95%, HR 55-95 BPM, Cabin CO2 < 0.35%, Cabin Pressure 14.2-14.9 psi, Radiation < 0.15 mSv/h.
flightSurgeonDirective: Telemetry nominal across Astroskin biometrics and ECLSS cabin sensors. Continue scheduled countermeasure exercise and fluid intake.
earthClinicDirective: Patient telemetry within normal clinical baseline. Continue routine hourly automated observation.

checklistSteps.instruction: Verify Astroskin thoracic band contact and Bluetooth LAN telemetry integrity.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Verify bedside pulse oximeter and 3-lead chest electrode adhesion.

checklistSteps.instruction: Complete daily 45-minute ARED resistive and cycle ergometer countermeasure session.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Maintain routine patient hydration and scheduled mobilization checks.

checklistSteps.instruction: Queue routine 6-hour medical summary packet for next Deep Space Network (DSN) window.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Archive patient vitals snapshot to local offline clinic database.

title: Acute Hypercapnia (Carbon Dioxide Toxicity)
earthClinicTitle: Acute Hypercapnic Respiratory Acidosis / Poor Ventilation
diagnosticCriteriaSummary: Cabin pCO2 > 0.50% (> 3.8 mmHg) AND Respiration > 22 BrPM AND HRV RMSSD suppression.
flightSurgeonDirective: WARNING: Cabin CO2 scrubber breakthrough detected with secondary crew tachypnea. Equip supplemental O2 mask immediately and replace LiOH/Amine canister in Module B.
earthClinicDirective: WARNING: Elevated CO2 retention and tachypnea detected. Initiate non-rebreather oxygen support, verify airway patency, and increase room ventilation immediately.

checklistSteps.instruction: Don portable 100% O2 mask from Locker Bay 2 to flush alveolar CO2 micro-pockets.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Apply high-flow supplemental oxygen mask and elevate head of bed to 45 degrees.

checklistSteps.instruction: Actuate ECLSS Inter-Module Ventilation (IMV) high-flow fan to disperse local CO2 pocket.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Open ward ventilation dampers and verify negative/positive pressure air exchange.

checklistSteps.instruction: Swap secondary Lithium Hydroxide (LiOH) scrubber cartridge in CDRA Rack B-02.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Check breathing circuit CO2 absorber canister and arterial/venous blood gas trend.

checklistSteps.instruction: Re-evaluate crew cognitive latency (PVT) and headache severity after 10 minutes on O2.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Re-assess Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) and respiratory rate after 10 minutes.

title: Acute Hypoxia & Cabin Atmospheric Decompression
timeToImpairmentText: < 6 minutes to Time of Useful Consciousness (TUC)
diagnosticCriteriaSummary: Astronaut SpO2 < 90% AND Heart Rate > 105 BPM AND Cabin Pressure < 12.0 psi.
flightSurgeonDirective: EMERGENCY: Rapid cabin depressurization and arterial desaturation (SpO2 < 90%). Put on your Quick-Don pressure mask IMMEDIATELY before attempting hull/valve isolation.
earthClinicDirective: EMERGENCY: Critical arterial desaturation (SpO2 < 90%) with compensatory tachycardia. Administer 15 L/min O2 via reservoir mask and prepare emergency airway kit.

checklistSteps.instruction: Don emergency Quick-Don positive-pressure oxygen mask from Bay 3 (pull red lanyard).
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Apply 15 L/min non-rebreather oxygen mask and verify chest rise bilaterally.

checklistSteps.instruction: Verify mask seal integrity and confirm regulator flow indicator shows continuous GREEN.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Check pulse oximeter perfusion index and verify O2 cylinder regulator pressure.

checklistSteps.instruction: Evacuate affected compartment to Core Habitat Airlock Shelter and seal Hatch H-02.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Position patient upright, clear airway secretions, and prepare bag-valve-mask (BVM).

checklistSteps.instruction: Actuate Manual N2/O2 High-Pressure Equalization Valve V-04 to restore 14.7 psi.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Record emergency incident snapshot to local database for medical evacuation handoff.

title: Solar Particle Event (SPE) Acute Radiation Exposure
earthClinicTitle: Acute Ionizing Radiation / Hazmat Exposure Alert
timeToImpairmentText: < 15 minutes to exceed ALARA acute prodromal threshold
diagnosticCriteriaSummary: Personal dosimeter rate > 5.0 mSv/hr OR habitat exterior proton flux > 100 MeV alert.
flightSurgeonDirective: RADIATION ALARM: Solar Particle Event proton flux spike (> 5.0 mSv/hr). Abort all outer-hull activities, retreat to the water-shielded Storm Shelter, and administer Amifostine prophylaxis.
earthClinicDirective: RADIATION / HAZMAT ALARM: Elevated ambient dosimetry rate. Relocate personnel to shielded interior zone and initiate prophylactic radioprotectant protocol.

checklistSteps.instruction: Retreat immediately to Central Water-Wall Storm Shelter (Aft Galley Polyethylene Bay).
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Evacuate patient and staff to shielded interior bunker or negative-pressure clean zone.

checklistSteps.instruction: Administer 500mg Amifostine (WR-2721) cytoprotective radioprotectant from Med-Kit Locker 2.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Administer prescribed radioprotectant / potassium iodide or chelating countermeasure.

checklistSteps.instruction: Consume +250ml High-Antioxidant Formulation Alpha (N-acetylcysteine + Vitamins C/E).
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Administer oral antiemetic (Ondansetron 8mg) and antioxidant hydration pack.

checklistSteps.instruction: Log personal active dosimeter cumulative mSv readout for OSD-379 genomic risk tracking.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Log cumulative dosimeter badge reading and schedule baseline lymphocyte count.

title: Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS) & Fluid Shift
earthClinicTitle: Elevated Intracranial / Intraocular Pressure & Optic Disc Edema
timeToImpairmentText: Progressive visual acuity shift & optic nerve sheath distension
diagnosticCriteriaSummary: Cephalic venous engorgement > +20% AND IOP > 18 mmHg OR Optic Nerve Sheath > 5.8 mm.
flightSurgeonDirective: SANS ADVISORY: Marked headward venous fluid shift (+22%) with elevated intraocular pressure and Grade 1-2 optic disc edema. Initiate Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) therapy and optical scan.
earthClinicDirective: NEURO-OCULAR ADVISORY: Elevated intraocular pressure and optic disc swelling detected. Perform fundus/optical scan and elevate patient head 30 degrees.

checklistSteps.instruction: Enter Lower Body Negative Pressure (LBNP) chamber at -30 mmHg for 30 minutes.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Elevate patient head-of-bed to 30 degrees and avoid jugular venous compression.

checklistSteps.instruction: Perform Multi-Modal Optical Scan of retinal optic disc and macula to grade papilledema.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Capture retinal fundus / anterior eye image via Multi-Modal Optical Scanner.

checklistSteps.instruction: Launch Guided Self-Assessment Wizard to measure Optic Nerve Sheath Diameter (ONSD).
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Perform guided point-of-care ocular ultrasound to measure optic nerve sheath.

checklistSteps.instruction: Restrict high-sodium ration packs (< 2.0g Na/day) and reduce cabin pCO2 target below 0.25%.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Restrict excess sodium infusion and monitor neurological visual field changes.

title: Severe Cognitive Fatigue & Circadian Misalignment
earthClinicTitle: Severe Clinician / Patient Autonomic Exhaustion & Sleep Debt
timeToImpairmentText: < 2 hours to critical psychomotor vigilance error threshold
diagnosticCriteriaSummary: 72h sleep debt > 6.0 hrs AND Resting HRV RMSSD < 25 ms AND Canaria Fatigue Index >= 65%.
flightSurgeonDirective: FATIGUE ALERT: Canaria Predictive Fatigue Index exceeds 65% with autonomic HRV suppression (< 25 ms). Restrict EVA and manual docking tasks immediately.
earthClinicDirective: FATIGUE ALERT: Severe autonomic stress and cumulative sleep debt detected. Mandate immediate rest rotation and 480nm alertness protocol.

checklistSteps.instruction: Reassign high-risk EVA, robotic arm, or manual thruster operations to rested crew member.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Rotate fatigued responder off high-acuity procedures and mandate rest break.

checklistSteps.instruction: Set Habitat Solid-State Lighting Assembly (SSLA) to 480nm blue-enriched phase reset.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Adjust clinical ward lighting and administer controlled hydration/electrolytes.

checklistSteps.instruction: Schedule uninterrupted 8-hour sleep block in acoustic crew quarters with melatonin 3mg.
checklistSteps.earthClinicInstruction: Log autonomic HRV recovery score after 6-hour protected rest window.
